name: trajectoryeval
description: Trajectory-match verifier sibling: checks the PATH a worker took (its ordered tool-call sequence) against an expected trajectory spec, in strict/unordered/subsequence modes. v0.1.2: e2e-tested `extract` → `check` pipeline (proves the real binary's actual-trajectory output feeds `check` byte-for-byte, no hand-written fixture in between), now wired live from condukt's Phase 6 `expected_trajectory` task field. Subscription-native (one bundled Rust binary, no API key).
